text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A summer event aimed at refreshing both 
mind and body... 
The "Summer Walk." Many Umamusume look 
forward to it, and—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—FR?!?! City... 
You can actually join this year's Summer 
Walk?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
I don't have any modeling gigs right now 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City can?! Since when does that happen?! 
Huh~... wait, really? Then where are we 
going? We're going together, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait... with you, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm gonna cry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, look at that face. ...I was kidding. 
Yeah, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, there's the tsundere, love to see it~ 
Knew it~. Wait, gotta buy new clothes! 
We gotta decide where to go too, right~? 
Shoot, I'm so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. First off, shopping, right? 
Let's go find something summery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I mean, it is a resort... maybe a 
sundress? 
Or something Hawaiian-ish? Maybe play it 
safe with some short shorts."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good, totally your vibe. But you 
didn't have to buy new clothes, you know. 
I could've lent you some. Aren't you 
broke?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm good! I wanna look super stylish and 
take tons of pics with you, City! 
I'll manage the cash by cutting back on 
snacks—ooh, cute...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, that one-piece is nice. 
...If I remember right, the fitting room 
has a powder room. I'll do your hair and 
makeup. ...Try it on?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa... Sooo super cute...! It's cute, 
but... 
Is it too frilly? It's pink and ruffly... 
isn't this totally not my style?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Why would you say that? 
It looks super good on you. Cute."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"!! 
...Seriously?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "What, you don't believe me?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Hehe, as if! Nope, not at all! 
Of course I believe the godly top-model 
City-sama!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Stop hyping me up. So, is that it for 
clothes? 
Let's head back and plan our sightseeing."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Huh! You're not buying any new clothes, 
City? 
I was kinda hoping for matching outfits... 
*glance, glance*"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Matching... 
.........Nah, I'll pass."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Pien. Alright, let's head hoooome."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I have a quick work thing to take 
care of, so go on ahead. 
Meet up in my room. I already got 
permission from Bamboo-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If we're shopping... maybe this area. 
Let's hit it up on day one. 
By the way, mind if I pick the hotel? 
There's a place I've been eyeing."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Totally, I trust your taste! In that 
case, I'll pick the food. 
It's cheat week, so I wanna go all out on 
meat! Meat is where it's at."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Planning your Summer Walk already, I 
see! 
Impressive to see you taking initiative so 
early!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Welcome back, Bamboo-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that location! You're heading to 
the same place as me! 
I'm doing my patrol rounds there this 
year!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Huh. ...Patrolling?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! It's a personal routine I do every 
year as Head of Discipline! 
I want the other committee members to 
rest, so it's just as much as I can handle 
alone!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Huuuuh... 
...Gotta watch ourselves."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, by the way, how's Present Day coming 
along? 
Wait, asking ruins it. Forget I said 
that."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Present Day...? What's that?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"We set up a 'Jordan Day' and a 'City Day' 
during the trip. 
We each plan our day in secret for the 
other."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...You two really are close, aren't you? 
It's quite fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"That came out of nowhere, lol. 
And kinda rude too."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't mean anything bad by it! 
It just crossed my mind!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"At first, I thought it was because you're 
birds of a feather... but your 
personalities 
are actually totally different, right? 
Even just seeing you two now."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"And you just blurted it out. How honest 
of you. ...Hmm, 
well, Jordan was the one who talked to me 
first."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, hold on. Aren't you... 
City, the model?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, for real! You're crazy gorgeous! 
Even cuter in real life! 
I've been seeing you in magazines forever! 
OMG! Can we get a pic for now?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't really do that. 
Sorry."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't see how you became friends 
from that at all?! 
Ah! Was there some fiery clash that 
brought you together... or something?!"

text_block_list.name: City & Jordan
text_block_list.text: "What brought us together..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of answer is that?! ...Well, 
whatever. I'm sure you'll be fine, but 
don't get too carried away just because 
it's the Summer Walk! See ya!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeeep... but like, not getting hyped is 
impossible. 
I mean... it's summer! We gotta party hard 
for Summer Walk!"
